source_caption_text:
Jay-Z immediately went quite when 4:44 started playing 😢❤️

Rick Rubin played “4:44” for JAY-Z during JAŸ-Z in 8, and the moment visibly moved him 🥹 The HBO docuseries pairs the two for conversations about JAY-Z’s music and the experiences behind it, revisiting more than 25 songs across eight episodes.

Released in 2017, “4:44” is one of JAY-Z’s most personal songs. He reflects on infidelity, regret, fatherhood and his relationship with Beyoncé, turning the track into a candid apology and a moment of self-examination. Years later, hearing it again with Rubin brought those feelings back into the room.

The song shares its title with JAY-Z’s 13th studio album, which debuted at No. 1 on the Billboard 200 with 262,000 equivalent album units. The title track peaked at No. 35 on the Billboard Hot 100, while nine of the album’s 10 songs charted on the Hot 100.

You can see why “4:44” still hits differently when JAY-Z revisits it. #JayZ #444 #RickRubin #HipHop
